text:
maya (support): Heads-up: Customer reported repeated 503s + garbled content. They attached a payload with possible PII. Request id r-1a2b3c4d. Need minimal repro and guidance on safe redaction before we share with eng.
lior (eng): Can you paste the original request metadata (headers) and the request_id? We need sequence of calls.
maya (support): Request id: r-1a2b3c4d; timestamp 2026-03-16T21:12:34Z. Customer included prompt with a name and an email. I can produce a sanitized curl if we want.
jess (oncall): +1 need debug bundle too. Prefer a pared-down bundle: request logs, model+version, client IP hash, and the exact prompt but redacted.
oscar (privacy): Note from privacy: do NOT include full emails, phone numbers, SSNs, or credit card numbers. Replace with tokens like [EMAIL], [PHONE], [SSN]. Also strip any auth tokens.
maya (support): Proposed sanitized prompt:
```
Customer: \"Hi, I'm [REDACTED_NAME] (owner of [COMPANY]). Please draft an email to [EMAIL] about invoice [INVOICE_ID].\"
```
lior (eng): That looks good. For repro curl include X-Request-ID header and replace Authorization with <REDACTED>. Example:
```
curl -v \"https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate\" \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>\" \\
  -H \"X-Request-ID: r-1a2b3c4d\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha","input":"<SANITIZED_PROMPT>","max_tokens":256}'
```
maya (support): I'll run that and attach logs. How do we upload the bundle?
jess (oncall): Use the support S3 presigned link (expires in 48h). Drop bundle as `debug-r-1a2b3c4d.tar.gz` and paste link here.
lior (eng): On eng side we'll need: request_id, server logs around the timestamp (±30s), model variant, and any shard errors. Don't include full auth headers.
oscar (privacy): Also pseudonymize client IPs: replace last octet with .0 (e.g., 203.0.113.5 -> 203.0.113.0) or provide SHA256 hash and indicate salt used.
maya (support): Uploading now. Attached: debug-r-1a2b3c4d.tar.gz (sanitized). Contents: request.json (sanitized), server.log.snip (±30s), model_meta.json, ingress.headers.redacted
sre-bot: incident-bundle created id db-1968-0001 for r-1a2b3c4d
lior (eng): Received. Quick checks: seeing a chain of 503s from backend pool A between 21:12:33–21:12:36, and a KV-cache miss storm. I'll triage and update.
oscar (privacy): Confirmed no raw PII in bundle. We can share with a narrow eng group. Legal ok with metadata only.
maya (support): Filing case to customer: \"We've collected a sanitized repro bundle and forwarded to engineering. We'll update within 24h.\" :thumbsup:
lior (eng): Assigning to infra oncall @jess for deeper investigate. Thanks everyone.
